query: What is Wise's most recently reported number of active customers, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Wise reported 16.2 million active customers for the first half of fiscal year 2027, which ended September 30, 2026 [1][2]. Regarding its workforce, Wise most recently reported employing 11,852 people, as indicated by current professional network data [3].
